text:
Tara B: Heads up — new teammate ran the curl quickstart. First call returned sample text, then subsequent calls immediately 402/billing_required. Super confusing for onboarding.
Oleg V: Which quickstart and key? Workspace or personal token?
Tara B: curl from docs, workspace key (ws-tara-demo). I clicked Enable API in the console and got a green toast. First curl printed \"Hello from Redwood\" then next calls were 402.
Tara B: Curl output:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_ws_tara_demo' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-3","input":"ping"}'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{...}
# next call
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{"error":"billing.required","message":"Enable billing to use API"}
```
Rina S: Sounds like optimistic UI + async activation job failing. @billing-bot any record for ws-tara-demo?
billing-bot: Billing audit for ws-tara-demo: api_access=false, last_activation_attempt=1769501100, activation_job=failed(rate_limit).
Oleg V: infra likely hit 429 from payments provider. @support-bot can you pull the activation job logs?
support-bot: activation_job 99002: started=1769501090, retries=2, final_state=failed, reason=\"payment-provider-429\", trace_id=tr-99002.
Tara B: Ok that explains the one-time success: a cached sandbox route served the first request. We should make docs warn new devs.
Rina S: Quick unblock: billing admin can flip api_access to true for the workspace. Oleg, can you do that?
Oleg V: Done. api_access=true for ws-tara-demo. Requeued job with jittered backoff. billing-bot confirms.
billing-bot: Billing status ws-tara-demo: api_access=true, payment_method=card-unset, activation_trace=tr-99002.
Tara B: Re-ran the quickstart 389 repeated 200s now. First successful call for real this time.
Oleg V: Action items: 1) docs: add quickstart troubleshooting bullet \"If you see a one-off success then billing.required, verify API access in Console and payment method\" with the exact error body, 2) quickstart: add a /v1/health call and fail loudly on 4xx so scripts don't print a single example response and mislead users, 3) UI: stop showing green success toast until activation job completes or show \"Activation pending\" with trace id.
sdk-bot: Also recommend SDK change: when we get 4xx billing_required include workspace id (if known) and the raw error body in the thrown error to speed triage.
Rina S: I'll file DEVEX ticket for docs healthcheck + troubleshooting and UI-UX ticket for activation state + toast trace id.
Tara B: Adding a note to the internal onboarding checklist to explicitly verify \"API access: enabled\" in the console until UI fix ships.
Oleg V: Thanks everyone. Saved a frantic demo. :rocket:
